column1: # manifest.tsv — the standardized MUTANT KILL-SET index for the invariant-hunt discovery track (#1724).
# One row per (contract-fixture, invariant-fixture) pair with its EXPECTED discrimination result. The
# self-test in ../mutant-kill.sh iterates this file: it stages the contract fixture to src/Target.sol and
# the invariant fixture to test/Inv.t.sol in a throwaway foundry project, runs the SAME evm-harness/
# forge-invariant.sh stateful-fuzzing gate the discovery track uses, maps its exit (1=FINDING=KILLED,
# 0=CLEAN=SURVIVED, 2=HARNESS_ERROR=ERROR), and asserts it equals the `expected` column.
# The three-way DISCRIMINATION per class proves a "kill" measures invariant EXPRESSIVENESS, not a rigged
# always-fire harness: the GOOD invariant KILLS the mutant AND SURVIVES the clean base twin, while the
# TOOTHLESS invariant SURVIVES the mutant. See README.md for the layout + the STABLE-CONTRACT-NAME rule.
# Columns (tab-separated): class  contract-fixture  invariant-fixture  expected(KILLED|SURVIVED)  note
# Fixtures resolve as mutants/<class>/<file>. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
